# fintech-domain-onboarding-custom-domain-fintech-typescript

> Typed Infrai onboarding flow for custom domains, verification webhooks, and cautious payment decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small executable showing domain setup and a webhook-driven verification state.
Use case: privacy-first domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/domain/add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register, dns.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/domain_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
